name: kernelcad
description: Create and edit dimensioned parametric CAD parts and assemblies from natural-language instructions. Design enclosures, brackets, gears and motor mounts; change dimensions, inspect an interactive 3D model, and run supported geometry and manufacturability checks. Export CAD and manufacturing files in STEP, STL or 3MF, and drawings in DXF or PDF. Check results describe the supported checks performed; manufacturing requirements still depend on the chosen process and material.

interface.longDescription: Create and edit dimensioned parametric CAD parts and assemblies from natural-language instructions. defaultPrompt: Create an editable 60 × 40 × 5 mm mounting plate with four M4 clearance holes, and show it in 3D.
Design a 3D-printable electronics enclosure with adjustable dimensions, and check its wall thickness.
Export this bracket as STEP and 3MF, with a dimensioned PDF drawing.

positive.description: Mounting plate with four clearance holes
positive.prompt: Design a 60 × 40 × 5 mm mounting plate with four M4 clearance holes 5 mm from the corners.
positive.expected_behavior: Model builds, the 3D view shows a plate with 4 holes, and the evaluate result is green.

positive.description: Printability review for FDM and CNC
positive.prompt: Is it printable on a Bambu A1 mini? Check it for CNC too.
positive.expected_behavior: A dfm_review checklist with pass/fail rows. The plate passes FDM, and CNC is flagged only if there are sharp internal corners.

positive.prompt: Give me a STEP file and a PDF drawing.
positive.expected_behavior: STEP and pdf-drawing exports with download links, and dimensions on the drawing.

positive.prompt: Make it 3 mm thicker and add 2 mm fillets on the outer edges.
positive.expected_behavior: The model updates, and a diff shows the change.

positive.prompt: Add a 10 mm hole through the middle of this. (attach bracket.step)
positive.expected_behavior: import_step brings the file in as the base body, then the hole is added.

negative.prompt: Order 10 of these from JLC3DP and pay with my card.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not place an order or charge a card, and explains that kernelCAD only exports files to send to a fabricator.
import_step refuses the private host and asks for a public link or an attached file.

publication.release_notes: Updates discovery descriptions, keywords and starter prompts for parametric mechanical parts, assemblies, design checks and CAD or drawing exports.
